concerns.text: FR‑008 is described in the plan as only a Kruskal‑Wallis test for bias across τ² levels (see Phase 4), but the specification (spec.md) requires a Shapiro‑Wilk normality test first and to fall back to Kruskal‑Wallis only if the normality test fails. The plan omits the Shapiro‑Wilk step, creating a mismatch with the functional requirement and the data‑model’s expectation for bias‑test p‑values.
